verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any bulk-operation capability, such as selecting many meetings or transcripts at once to delete, move, tag, share, or export them. The closest items are adjacent features: cross-meeting search and analysis via AI Chat and MCP, automatic per-meeting syncs to S3, Airtable or Drive, and auto-joining all meetings. These are read-only queries or recurring per-item automations, not bulk actions on many items at once.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
